slug: 2025-09-26 Mali introduces new platforms to enhance digital public service access

systems.owner: Ministry of Territorial Administration and Decentralisation

note: Platforms presented on 16 September 2025 are for transport documents, tolls, health records and, in SIGIP, data confidentiality, association monitoring and public-servant attendance; none is described as registering births or deaths. The article adds only that birth registration is around 90 percent, a share of events.
